title.zh: 设置交集大小至少为二
title.en: Set Intersection Size At Least Two

desc.zh: 从手选整数推导最右贪心，用两个最大点维护所有区间的覆盖。
desc.en: Derive rightmost greedy choices and cover intervals using only the two largest selected points.

complexity: O(n log n) time; O(n) auxiliary space for sorting

concepts.name: Rightmost two-point interval cover
concepts.description: Sort by end and maintain the two largest chosen integers.

concepts.name: Greedy exchange proof
concepts.description: Move required points right while preserving a feasible optimal extension.
